title: Pakistan Flight-Tests Its First Indigenous Air-to-Air Missile, Fa'az, From a JF-17: What Is and Is Not Known
excerpt: Pakistan announced a flight test of its first indigenously developed air-to-air missile, Fa'az, on Nov. 3, 2026. It was fired from a JF-17; no range or target data was released.
rank_math_title: Pakistan tests Fa'az air-to-air missile from JF-17 | Envanter Medya
rank_math_description: Pakistan fired its first indigenous air-to-air missile, Fa'az, from a JF-17. The round was the Fa'az-IIR; range, speed and target data were not released.
